evaluation_contract.primary_development_metric: paired source-group OOF background efficiency at signal efficiency 0.585957
evaluation_contract.test_policy: Test is opened exactly once after final model-family and analysis choices are locked. Post-test retuning is prohibited.
evaluation_contract.validation_policy: Validation remains sealed until folds, event universe, reconstruction, features, model budgets, score operating points, and weighting policies are frozen.

auxiliary_qcd_balance_waiver.mitigation: Use the same frozen hierarchical comparison-weight or sampler contract for every trainable classifier; fix the total auxiliary-QCD loss budget per training fold; exclude auxiliary QCD from physical yields and significance; report auxiliary-domain performance separately.
auxiliary_qcd_balance_waiver.reason: Only the train-only, classification-only auxiliary-QCD population missed the predeclared row-balance threshold. Primary signal, primary background, total broad rows, assignment supervision, and process coverage all passed. The 23 auxiliary source groups are indivisible and are not authorized for physical-yield evaluation.

next: freeze exact common geometric reconstruction, candidate feature schema, comparison-weight table, and physical-weight authorization before running the baseline ladder
scope: common train-only source-group folds and benchmark governance for resolved HH to 4b baseline and SPA-Net comparisons

weight_contract.comparison_training_weights: To be materialized and frozen before training. Equalize total signal and background; ggF and VBF within signal; frozen background families within background; source groups within families; and broad rows within source groups. These weights are for learning and comparison only.
weight_contract.physical_weights: Separate CMS Run-2 138 fb^-1 expected-yield weights for the 441 primary sources only. They remain unauthorized until the cross-section, sum-of-weights, QCD stitching, and luminosity registry passes its dedicated freeze gate.
weight_contract.spanet_target_mass_weights: Separate target-wise assignment/detection loss weights, to be derived from train-only Higgs-target mass spectra after the partial-target overlay is frozen. Never substitute them for classification or physical weights.
